description: Get the messages of one Inbox conversation: the newest 500, oldest first, each with its direction (in from the other person, out sent by the workspace), text, attachments and time. Reading does not mark the conversation read. The Inbox is part of the Pro and Business plans; on other plans, or before it is available to the account, the call is refused with a message saying so. Use this when the user wants to read one Inbox conversation in full.
name: get_conversation

direction.description: in (from the other person) or out (sent by the workspace).

title: Get Inbox conversation
